findings.title: Output format restated in several places
findings.problem: The table and spoken-reply format is defined in the Goal line and again in the Pipeline stages, so the same contract is stated twice.
findings.proof: Goal: a spoken summary of at most 15 seconds and an on-screen table of up to three products with the columns Product, Price, Rating, Ingredients (materials and claims), Source, Citation.
findings.fix: Keep the output format once in the Goal line and reference it from the Final answer stage.

findings.title: No rule against inferring sensitive traits for personalization
findings.problem: The use case is recommendations and personalization, yet the system prompt has no rule forbidding inference of sensitive attributes (health, age, family status) from the shopper's wording, and no rule limiting profiling to the current conversation beyond the state rule. This belongs in the system_prompt Safety policy.
findings.fix: Add a Safety policy rule that the assistant uses only constraints the shopper states explicitly and never infers health, family or other sensitive attributes to rank products.

findings.title: Ambiguous rule for when to call both web kinds
findings.problem: The web.search schema says to call both kinds for a price and a property, while the Planner rule limits the live web to what the catalog cannot know, so the planner cannot tell whether a shopping and a web call are both required.
findings.proof: Call both when a shopper asks for a price *and* a property.
findings.fix: State in the Planner rule the exact condition for two web calls (shopping plus web) and make the schema match it.

findings.title: web.search price_max leaves unpriced results undefined
findings.problem: The price_max description does not say whether results with no price are kept or dropped, which affects budget checks since price is only sometimes stated.
findings.proof: `price_max` leaves out results priced above a budget (the budget goes here, not into the query words)
findings.fix: Add one sentence stating whether unpriced results pass the filter and how the reply should treat them.

findings.title: No guidance when a matched product has empty ingredients or materials
findings.problem: The context requires an Ingredients column filled from cited sources but says nothing about what the Answerer should write when a catalog listing has no materials or claims and no web source states them.
findings.fix: Add an explicit rule that an empty materials or claims field is shown as 'not stated' with its source, mirroring the Rating column rule.

findings.title: No model-side rule against tool-result instructions that request tool calls
findings.problem: Untrusted-text rules cover following and repeating instructions, but no rule tells the Retriever or Planner to ignore a tool result that asks for another search or a different tool.
findings.fix: Add to the Untrusted content rule that tool results never change the planned calls, which are set only by the Planner and the Retriever's two-round limit.

findings.title: Loosening rule duplicated in system prompt and tool schema
findings.problem: The catalog tool's loosening order is described in the rag.search schema and then restated in the system prompt's Search section, so the same behaviour is paid for twice.
findings.proof: Loosening: when fewer products than `top_k` meet every filter, filters are loosened in this order until enough are found: claims, materials,
findings.fix: Keep the full loosening order in the schema and cut the system prompt sentence to a reference to the schema.

findings.title: Search section repeats the schema loosening sentence
findings.problem: The system prompt's Search bullet restates the catalog loosening and miss-marking that the schema already defines.
findings.proof: When too few products meet them the catalog tool loosens some (never a stated age range or a safety exclusion) and marks what each product misses, which the reply says.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence or reduce it to 'the catalog tool loosens filters as its schema describes, and the reply says what was missed'.
